description: The one signed Alpha Phone update channel for Pixel 10a (stallion) on Android 17 (issue #400). scripts/sign-aosp-release.mjs refuses to sign while a field here is UNSET: the OTA package certificate (releasekey x509, installed as otacerts by sign_target_files_apks -o) and the AVB public key must match the runtime key directory. Alpha Compute holds signing and update authority; the release owner is accountable for support and rollback. No key material, URL credential or recovery code belongs here. Drill results are recorded from executed drills, never by software.
